title: 12-Fold Random PUB: Single CAMELS Forcing
subtitle: 12-fold random spatial cross-validation & CONUS MPR over the 1989–1999 Newman evaluation decade.

rows.paradigm: Regional Long Short-Term Memory Network (12-Fold PUB)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated in Kratzert et al. (2019a) on Split-3 (trained on WY1981–1995, evaluated on WY1996–2010; 1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30) with extended NLDAS-2 forcing.
rows.family_description: Regional single-layer 256-unit Long Short-Term Memory network (CudaLSTM, 270-day lookback window) receiving daily extended NLDAS-2 meteorological forcings concatenated with 27 static CAMELS catchment attributes, trained with basin-averaged NSE* loss across 12 spatial k-fold cross-validation splits (PUB, 10 seeds per fold) over WY1981–1995 (1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30) and evaluated over WY1996–2010 (1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019a, WRR, Table 2; HydroShare 10.4211/hs.0a68bfd7ddf642a8be9041d60f40868c).
rows.notes: 12-fold spatial k-fold cross-validation (PUB) of the 270-day lookback regional LSTM with 27 static catchment attributes on extended NLDAS-2 forcings (10 random seeds per fold; trained on WY1981–1995 [1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30] and evaluated on WY1996–2010 [1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30] across 531 CAMELS-US basins) from Kratzert et al. (2019a, WRR, Table 2; HydroShare 10.4211/hs.0a68bfd7ddf642a8be9041d60f40868c): Ensemble Med NSE = 0.691 (0.69 ± 0.004), Mean NSE = 0.608, Med KGE = 0.689, Med |FHV| = 20.4%, 24 basins with NSE <= 0.

rows.family_description: 16-bucket differentiable HBV 1.1p (δMG) with capillary rise flux and time-varying (dynamic) soil-moisture recharge exponent β, near-surface recession coefficient K0, and ET shape parameter γ predicted daily by a 256-unit DropConnect LSTM with 15-day Gamma unit-hydrograph routing.
rows.notes: Clean-room PyTorch + C++/OpenMP re-implementation of Song et al. (2024) δHBV 1.1p evaluated under 12-fold random spatial cross-validation (PUB) across 531 CAMELS-US basins with Daymet forcing; 5-seed ensemble mean (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555; Med NSE = 0.690).

rows.family_description: 16-bucket differentiable HBV 1.1p (δMG) with capillary rise flux and time-varying (dynamic) soil-moisture recharge exponent β, near-surface recession coefficient K0, and ET shape parameter γ predicted daily by a 256-unit DropConnect LSTM with 15-day Gamma unit-hydrograph routing.
rows.notes: Clean-room PyTorch + C++/OpenMP re-implementation of Song et al. (2024) δHBV 1.1p evaluated under 12-fold random spatial cross-validation (PUB) across 531 CAMELS-US basins with Daymet forcing; single-model performance averaged across all 5 random seeds (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555; Med NSE = 0.686 ± 0.004).

rows.family_description: Differentiable process-based HBV 1.0 model coupling a regional 256-unit cuDNN LSTM parameter network with 16 parallel sub-basin conceptual HBV rainfall-runoff buckets (dynamic daily soil-moisture nonlinearity BETA and evapotranspiration exponent BETAET alongside 11 static bucket parameters) and a shared 15-day Gamma unit hydrograph routing kernel, trained end-to-end with combined linear/log-sqrt RMSE loss.
rows.notes: 5-seed ensemble (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555) evaluated under 12-fold random spatial cross-validation (PUB) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 with Daymet forcing.

rows.family_description: Regional 3-layer Multilayer Perceptron (2048 hidden units) mapping static catchment attributes to time-invariant parameters of a 16-component parallel differentiable HBV rainfall-runoff model with Gamma unit-hydrograph routing.
rows.notes: Poudel & Steinschneider (2026) Static-Parameter MLP + 16-HBV (50 epochs x 240 batches/epoch) evaluated under 12-fold spatial cross-validation (PUB) across 531 CAMELS-US basins with Daymet forcing; 3-seed ensemble mean (seeds 101, 102, 103; Ensemble Med NSE = 0.678).

rows.family_description: Differentiable process-based HBV 1.0 model coupling a regional 256-unit cuDNN LSTM parameter network with 16 parallel sub-basin conceptual HBV rainfall-runoff buckets (dynamic daily soil-moisture nonlinearity BETA and evapotranspiration exponent BETAET alongside 11 static bucket parameters) and a shared 15-day Gamma unit hydrograph routing kernel, trained end-to-end with combined linear/log-sqrt RMSE loss.
rows.notes: Single-model evaluation scored across all 5 individual seed members (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555; evaluation_mode='single_member_mean') under 12-fold random spatial cross-validation (PUB) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 with Daymet forcing.

rows.family_description: Regional 3-layer Multilayer Perceptron (2048 hidden units) mapping static catchment attributes to time-invariant parameters of a 16-component parallel differentiable HBV rainfall-runoff model with Gamma unit-hydrograph routing.
rows.notes: Poudel & Steinschneider (2026) Static-Parameter MLP + 16-HBV (50 epochs x 240 batches/epoch) evaluated under 12-fold spatial cross-validation (PUB) across 531 CAMELS-US basins with Daymet forcing; single-model performance averaged across all 3 random seeds (seeds 101, 102, 103; Single-Seed Med NSE = 0.669 ± 0.001).

rows.paradigm: Regional Long Short-Term Memory Network (12-Fold PUB)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated in Kratzert et al. (2019a) on Split-3 (trained on WY1981–1995, evaluated on WY1996–2010; 1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30) with extended NLDAS-2 forcing.
rows.family_description: Regional single-layer 256-unit Long Short-Term Memory network (CudaLSTM, 270-day lookback window) receiving daily extended NLDAS-2 meteorological forcings concatenated with 27 static CAMELS catchment attributes, trained with basin-averaged NSE* loss across 12 spatial k-fold cross-validation splits (PUB, 10 seeds per fold) over WY1981–1995 (1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30) and evaluated over WY1996–2010 (1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019a, WRR, Table 2; HydroShare 10.4211/hs.0a68bfd7ddf642a8be9041d60f40868c).
rows.notes: Single-model evaluation under 12-fold spatial k-fold cross-validation (PUB) of the 270-day lookback regional LSTM with 27 static catchment attributes on extended NLDAS-2 forcings (trained on WY1981–1995 [1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30] and evaluated on WY1996–2010 [1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30] across 531 CAMELS-US basins) from Kratzert et al. (2019a, WRR, Table 2; HydroShare 10.4211/hs.0a68bfd7ddf642a8be9041d60f40868c): Single-Model Med NSE = 0.640 (0.64 ± 0.004), Mean NSE = 0.562, Med KGE = 0.648, Med |FHV| = 21.9%, 31 basins with NSE <= 0.

rows.paradigm: Conceptual Soil Moisture Accounting + Snow-17 Model (DDS & 29-D Donor Transfer)
rows.family_description: Clean-room C++17/OpenMP and Python re-implementation of coupled Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + 15-day Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph (27 calibrated parameters) calibrated per basin using Dynamically Dimensioned Search (DDS; Tolson & Shoemaker, 2007) over WY2000–2008 (Nearing et al., 2020), and extended to ungauged 12-fold PUB and 18-fold HUC-02 PUR prediction via k=1 nearest-neighbor donor parameter transfer in a 29-dimensional joint geographic and standardized static catchment-attribute space.
rows.notes: 12-fold spatial cross-validation (PUB) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins on Daymet forcings: training basins calibrated per fold via DDS (400 iterations, 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30), and held-out ungauged test basins predicted via k=1 nearest-neighbor parameter transfer in a 29-D joint (0.2*lat, 0.2*lon) + 27 standardized static catchment-attribute space (1 seed; Median NSE = 0.564).

rows.paradigm: Conceptual Lumped Rainfall-Runoff Model (100-Member Calibrated Ensemble & 1000-Member Uncalibrated Random Ensemble)
rows.family_description: Conceptual semi-distributed/lumped HBV-light rainfall-runoff model (Seibert & Vis, 2012) providing dual upper and lower reference benchmarks on all 531 CAMELS-US basins forced by Maurer meteorology (Seibert et al., 2018; executed by Jan Seibert and Marc Vis for Kratzert et al., 2019b; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1): HBV-upper (gauged__single_camels) is the 100-member genetically calibrated GAP ensemble upper benchmark over WY2000–2008, and HBV-lower (pub__single_camels) is the 1000-member uncalibrated random-parameter ensemble lower benchmark sampled uniformly from physically plausible parameter bounds (using zero target or donor streamflow observations, NOT a donor-transfer calibration).
rows.notes: Lower benchmark (HBV_lb): 1000-member uncalibrated random-parameter ensemble lower benchmark with parameter sets sampled uniformly at random from physically plausible bounds (using zero target-basin and zero donor-basin streamflow observations; NOT a donor-transfer calibration; evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins; HydroShare archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1, NetCDF variable HBV_lb; stores the pre-computed 1000-member ensemble mean hydrograph as 1 array at gs://camels-us-mip/hydrographs/pub__single_camels/t7_23.zarr; Median NSE = 0.420 on 531 basins, 0.416 on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. 2019b Table 3 intersection).

protocol.benchmark_name: CAMELS-531 Unified Model Intercomparison Project (Newman Period)
protocol.train_period: 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 (9 water years, water years 2000–2008; 3,288 daily steps)
protocol.eval_period: 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (10 water years, water years 1990–1999; 3652 daily steps)

spatial_regimes.title: Gauged Simulation
spatial_regimes.description: Temporal split-sample across all 531 CAMELS-US benchmark basins: calibrated/trained on water years 2000–2008 (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30) and evaluated out-of-sample on water years 1990–1999 (1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30).

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Basins (12-Fold Random PUB)
spatial_regimes.description: Out-of-sample spatial cross-validation across k = 12 random folds of the 531 basins (44–45 basins/fold), trained on 11 folds during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out fold during water years 1990–1999.

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Regions (18-Fold HUC-02 PUR)
spatial_regimes.description: Zero-shot regional extrapolation across all 18 USGS two-digit HUC-02 hydrologic regions: trained on 17 regions during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out HUC-02 region during water years 1990–1999.

forcing_regimes.title: Single CAMELS Forcing
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by a single standard CAMELS-US meteorological dataset (Daymet, Maurer, or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: Multiple CAMELS Forcings
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven simultaneously by any combination of two or three standard CAMELS-US meteorological datasets (Daymet, Maurer, and/or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: With Lagged Streamflow Inputs
forcing_regimes.description: Models ingesting lagged observed streamflow, autoregression, or data assimilation alongside meteorological forcings (or donor-gauge transfer in PUB/PUR).

forcing_regimes.title: Freeform Forcings (Non-CAMELS Inputs)
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by non-CAMELS meteorological forcing products (such as AORC, EM-Earth, or ERA5-Land).

provenance_categories.Literature: Skill scores extracted directly from a published paper evaluated on the standard splits.
provenance_categories.Archive: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs associated with a prior published paper.
provenance_categories.Archive*: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs on a partial basin subset (<531 basins) or non-standard time period.
provenance_categories.MIP Re-run: Published model re-implemented and re-run by the MIP on the standardized 531-basin splits.
provenance_categories.Contribution: New model contributed directly to the MIP benchmark.
